claims.claim: A deficit rate for real-world records

claims.claim: JRS is certification, accreditation or a credential
claims.limitations: Explicitly disclaimed on compliance.html and in the guides.

claims.claim: The 70% figure is a pre-registered threshold that was CLEARED
claims.limitations: It is a success threshold for human detection, not a deficit rate. Both public occurrences state it as cleared.

claims.claim: JRS output is admissible in court
claims.limitations: NOT ESTABLISHED. Admissibility is a legal determination (Rule 8).
NOT ESTABLISHED, and the banned-language list in Section 24 covers it.

claims.claim: JRS satisfies a statute, regulation or standard
claims.limitations: Rule 9. No regulatory crosswalk has been performed.

claims.claim: JRS is an industry standard or has industry recognition
claims.limitations: NOT ESTABLISHED. No standards body, no DOI, no publisher record for any JRS output.

claims.claim: Real-world effectiveness of JRS in production use
claims.limitations: No real-case criterion validity study exists. The site says so.

claims.claim: Sixteen experts across eleven countries read a balanced 24-record corpus cold
claims.limitations: Constructed corpus, deliberately balanced. Supports detectability only.

_evidence_chain_rule: CLAIM -> EVIDENCE -> LIMITATION -> RIGHTS -> REGULATORY IMPLICATION -> APPROVAL (Section 24)
